deploy-bot: [deploybot] Starting rollout wave 2 for release/v2.2.0 (commit a1b2c3d). Sequence: us -> eu -> apac. Env: prod. Change window: 23:00-03:00 UTC. Canary config: 5% 10m -> 20% 10m -> full. Metrics: infra.latency, infra.error_rate, model.qps. Release notes: https://redwood.dev/releases/v2.2.0

anna: Kicking off canary in us-east now. pinging @jamal for infra watch. will keep the canary run 10m and report.

jamal: on it. set alerts: latency > 2x baseline and error_rate > 0.5% for immediate notify.

deploy-bot: Canary us-east: STATUS=green, step=5% -> progressed to 20% (ok at minute 8).

priya: saw a small tail-latency bump (~8-10ms) at 20% but p95 still within SLO. no error increase. continuing.

liu: rolling us-west now (same canary slice).
deploy-bot: us-west: STATUS=green, completed. US region rollout: COMPLETE (green).

deploy-bot: Starting EU canary (eu-central).

deploy-bot: eu-central canary: anomaly detected — tokenization-service errors increased to 1.2% at minute 6.

anna: seeing the tokenization spike in EU as well. not safe to progress. I'm going to pin EU back to the last stable tag to contain blast radius. @deploy-bot run: `pin-region --region eu --tag release/v2.1.9`

deploy-bot: Action executed: pin-region --region eu --tag release/v2.1.9. EU traffic routed to release/v2.1.9. Starting rollback of EU canary. (audit id: roll-eu-1887654321)

jamal: metrics post-rollback look good, error_rate returned to baseline within 2 mins. APAC should remain paused until we investigate.

priya: suggestion — when we re-run EU canary, use reduced batch size and enable additional tokenizer logging. suspect quantization patch may have interacted with tokenizer shimming.

anna: agree. reschedule EU reattempt for 02:00 UTC tomorrow in the maintenance window. For now APAC=paused, EU=pinned->rollback, US=done.

sara: I'll update the release notes + status on the rollout board. adding note: "EU rollback due to tokenization errors; reattempt scheduled." tagging the infra team for follow-up.

anna: final commands to capture in the runbook: `deploybot status --run 1887654321` and `deploybot mark-region-status --region eu --status pinned --note "tokenizer error spike"`.

deploy-bot: Region statuses summary: US=complete-green, EU=pinned (rolled back to release/v2.1.9), APAC=paused. Commit/tag: a1b2c3d / release/v2.2.0. Wave 2: partial completion.

jamal: thumbs up. will open a short postmortem if the tokenizer investigation points to a regression.

anna: thanks everyone. closing this thread — will post follow-up once EU reattempt is scheduled. :white_check_mark:
